iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

DHCPv4::giaddr
       This command returns giaddr (gateway or relay IP) field from DHCPv4 message.

SYNOPSIS
       DHCPv4::giaddr

DESCRIPTION
       This command returns giaddr (gateway or relay IP) field from DHCPv4 message

       Details (syntax): DHCPv4:: giaddr

RETURN VALUE
       This command returns giaddr (gateway or relay IP) field from DHCPv4 message

VALID DURING
EXAMPLES
	when CLIENT_DATA {
	    log local0. "Giaddr [DHCPv4::giaddr]"
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.6.0
	   --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
